Maria (CS Ops): Heads up — I'm scheduling an automated ownership reconciliation tonight at 11:00pm PT to clean up orphaned accounts and normalize playbook assignments. Need a quick sanity check on feedback mapping for onboarding flows before we run.
Aj (CS Data): Ack. Which fields are we treating as authoritative for owner/channel mapping?
Maria (CS Ops): Source of truth will be accounts.owner_id, but we'll use playbook_assignments.latest_owner as a secondary source when owner_id is null and locked=false. We won't touch accounts with do_not_reassign = true.
Sam (Acct Exec): Thanks — please exempt any accounts with open renewal tickets or active proof-of-concepts. We had one POC yesterday that got reassigned accidentally last time.
Jordan (CS Manager): Can you list exemption rules? I want to confirm for my team.
Maria (CS Ops): Exemptions: tier = enterprise, tags contain "vip" or "poc-active", or account_metadata.do_not_reassign = true. Also we'll skip accounts with renewal_status in ("at-risk","negotiation").
Aj (CS Data): For feedback capture, are we moving survey responses into playbook logs or into support_notes? Prefer support_notes for searchability.
Maria (CS Ops): Good call — map onboarding_survey.responses -> support_notes with prefix "OnboardFeedback:". Playbook logs stay for automation events only. I'll attach a dry-run CSV that shows proposed owner changes + the feedback mapping.
Sam (Acct Exec): Can you add a rollback flag and an easy query to find changed accounts? I'd rather have a one-liner we can run if something goes south.
Maria (CS Ops): Yup. Rollback strategy: we write reconciliation_runs.run_id and old_owner into a history table. Quick revert query:
```
-- revert to previous owner for run 774
UPDATE accounts a
SET owner_id = h.old_owner
FROM reconciliation_history h
WHERE a.account_id = h.account_id
AND h.run_id = 774
AND a.do_not_reassign = false;
```
Aj (CS Data): Perfect. Please include me on the run results and the CSV link. I'll scan for any accounts where owner changes drop entropy (i.e., reassigning multiple times).
reconcile-bot: Scheduled reconciliation job queued (run_id=774) — dry-run available: https://internal.redwood/sheets/recon-run-774.csv :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Maria (CS Ops): I'll post the CSV in this thread once the dry-run completes. If anyone wants their segment excluded, reply with a list of account_ids before 10pm PT. Otherwise we'll proceed with the run at 11pm and follow up with a short rollback guide. :thumbsup:
